title: The Vocabulary Tax: Safely Trimming Unused Tokens from LLMs for On-Device Use
abstract: arXiv:2611.19913v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open large language models (LLMs) and speech models ship vocabularies of up to 262k tokens, and every user downloads the tables those tokens index (the input embedding, an untied output head and, in recent on-device models, per-layer embeddings), whatever languages they need. We call the bytes in rows a deployment never uses the vocabulary tax and measure it, without downloading weights, for 1,244 generative and speech-recognition models on the Hugging Face Hub. For a Thai and English deployment it is a median 4.4% of model bytes below 0.5B parameters and 2.1% above 8B, and 1.93 GB in Gemma 4 E2B: it falls hardest on the small models that edge devices run. Keeping only the rows of the deployment's writing systems is exact. translated_title: 词汇税：为设备端使用安全裁剪大语言模型中未使用的词元
translated_abstract: 开源大语言模型（LLM）和语音模型附带高达26.2万个词元的词汇表，无论用户需要何种语言，每个用户都要下载这些词元所索引的表格（输入嵌入、未绑定的输出头，以及近年设备端模型中的逐层嵌入）。我们将部署中从未使用的词汇表字节称为“词汇税”，并在无需下载权重的情况下，对Hugging Face Hub上1,244个生成式和语音识别模型进行了测量。对于泰语和英语部署场景，该税收在参数量低于0.5B的模型中占模型字节的中位数4.4%，在参数量超过8B的模型中占2.1%，在Gemma 4 E2B中高达1.93 GB：这一负担最沉重地落在边缘设备所运行的小模型上。仅保留部署所用书写系统对应的词元行是精确无损的做法；而保留用户自身文本中出现过的词元则能移除更多内容（参数量低于0.5B的模型中位数为29.0%），但通常的做法会破坏BPE分词器：它会丢弃合并操作所依赖的中间词元，导致新文本……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“词汇税”概念，量化了大语言模型词汇表中未使用词元造成的存储浪费（对边缘设备上的小模型影响最大），并提出在保持BPE分词器正确性的前提下安全裁剪这些未使用词元以缩小设备端模型体积。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "vocabulary tax"—quantifying the storage wasted on unused vocabulary tokens across 1,244 open LLMs and speech models, which burdens small on-device models most—and proposes safely trimming such tokens while preserving tokenizer correctness.
